concept: At dusk in a modest apartment kitchen, hands set one blank paper slip aside from a small stack while the phone lies dark, visually expressing one concern at a time.
sourceBody: When your mind keeps rehearsing what might go wrong, bring one concern at a time before God. Philippians 4:6-7 joins prayer and thanksgiving with God’s guarding peace. You do not have to solve the whole future tonight; take the next faithful step and entrust what you cannot control.
